items.text: WR Ja’Marr Chase is out due to a concussion. Earlier evaluated, return questionable then ruled out.
items.implication: Sit; Tee Higgins and Chase Brown see boost.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Higgins; RB involvement up.

items.text: The Eagles have downgraded RB Saquon Barkley to out (hamstring). Schefter confirmed after Q to return.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down to backups like Gainwell if listed.

items.text: ETR weekend summary lists Puka Nacua as EXPECTED TO PLAY; Levitan notes only small dock on groin with Rams intending no workload limit per Schefter.
items.why: Full participant Friday; Schefter sources confirm no intended snap limit though conditioning could still factor.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected vs Eagles; upgrade from limited return scenarios.

items.text: Ladd McConkey EXPECTED TO PLAY; Levitan bigger dock on foot/ribs. Schefter confirms active.
items.why: Foot/ribs issues but cleared; Derwin James inactive same team.
items.implication: Start but monitor for limited snaps.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin, dealing with a hamstring injury, officially is inactive today in London vs. the Colts. ETR had as NOT EXPECTED.
Chiefs downgraded WR Rashee Rice to doubtful today due to a hamstring injury. Rapoport confirms.
Ravens QB Lamar Jackson believed day-to-day with ankle injury; left stadium in protective boot per Schefter. Q to return then monitored next week.
items.why: Ankle; Huntley in for third quarter.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; Flowers/Henry still viable short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream if out; RBs safer.

items.text: Add Lamar to Saquon, Chase, DJ Moore and Mariota among players leaving the game early. Two Bhayshul Tuten TDs called back due to penalty.
items.implication: Live fantasy pivots to backups/beneficiaries; Tuten volume real but TD luck bad.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers, on injury report for knee plus illness, fully expected to play vs Chiefs.
items.why: Knee + late illness but team expects play.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: RT Lane Johnson (personal Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion). Major offensive depletion.
items.implication: Hurts offense; Saquon already out compounds. AJ Brown or others if available elevated but protection issues.
items.opportunity: Backups and remaining pass-catchers see more volume.

items.text: Only small dock on Puka Nacua (groin) now; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Tinier on Flowers; bigger on McConkey/Evans.
items.implication: Nacua/Flowers closer to full; McConkey/Evans more cautious starts.
items.opportunity: Prefer Nacua/Flowers usage over docked ones.

items.text: Zay Flowers listed EXPECTED TO PLAY; Levitan tiny dock on hamstring, no hard pitch count per beat.
items.implication: Must-start WR with focal role in Ravens pass attack.
items.opportunity: High target share if Lamar limited later.

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/OPTIMISTIC; later confirmed active by Rapoport after practicing through ribs.
items.why: Ribs; optimistic team reports, Kittle noted fractured ribs suck but Evans active.
items.implication: Startable WR with bigger dock per Levitan.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker is inactive tonight. ETR had as NOT EXPECTED.
Packers ruled out star LB Edgerrin Cooper with Achilles injury; belief torn, season-ending per coach 'Not good.'
items.implication: Defensive impact; GB run defense weaker potentially boosting opposing RBs.

items.text: Eagles listing OT Lane Johnson as questionable for today’s game vs. the Rams due to personal reasons. Levitan flags as part of depletion.
items.implication: OL issues compound Eagles offensive woes with other outs.

items.text: Tyjae Spears EXPECTED TO PLAY in weekend summary.
